signature_matches.name: contains PDB path
signature_matches.description: executable/pe/pdb
signature_matches.rule_src:
rule:
  meta:
    name: contains PDB path
    namespace: executable/pe/pdb
    authors:
      - moritz.raabe@mandiant.com
    scopes:
      static: file
      dynamic: file
    examples:
      - 464EF2CA59782CE697BC329713698CCC  # level32.exe
  features:
    - string: /:\\.*\.pdb/

signature_matches.name: implement COM DLL
signature_matches.description: executable/pe
signature_matches.rule_src:
rule:
  meta:
    name: implement COM DLL
    namespace: executable/pe
    authors:
      - moritz.raabe@mandiant.com
    scopes:
      static: file
      dynamic: file
    references:
      - https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/win32/api/combaseapi/nf-combaseapi-dllgetclassobject
  features:
    - and:
      - export: DllGetClassObject
      - optional:
        - export: DllRegisterServer
